description.en: Maps research device ids to symbols of the repo library (cad/symbols). Ports come from the library _catalog.json. Nothing verified.
description.es: Mapea ids de dispositivos investigados a simbolos de la biblioteca del repo (cad/symbols). Los puertos vienen de _catalog.json. Nada verificado.
